<style id="dyContinuousMotionStyle">.kvsd-mqwrap,.kn-rowwrap,.dyw-marquee,.marquee,.ar-viewport,.dy-related-viewport{cursor:grab;touch-action:pan-y;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain}.dy-grabbing{cursor:grabbing!important}.dy-grabbing a,.dy-grabbing button{pointer-events:none}.dy-native-loop{scrollbar-width:none!important;-ms-overflow-style:none}.dy-native-loop::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none!important}
</style>
<script id="dyContinuousMotionScript">
(function(w,d){'use strict';
 /* Homepage motion is intentionally owned by the Theme and remains unchanged. */
 if(d.body&&d.body.classList.contains('fk-home'))return;
 var reduced=w.matchMedia&&w.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 function bind(view,track,speed,auto){
 if(!view||view.dataset.dyMotion)return;view.dataset.dyMotion='3';view.classList.add('dy-native-loop');
 if(track){track.style.animation='none';track.style.animationPlayState='running';track.style.transform='none';track.style.flexWrap='nowrap';track.style.maxWidth='none'}
 var drag=null,moved=false,last=0,pausedUntil=0,hover=false;
 function cycle(){if(!track)return 0;var first=track.querySelector('.dyw-category-copy,.dy-related-group');return first?first.scrollWidth:track.scrollWidth/2}
 function normalize(){var c=cycle();if(c>0){while(view.scrollLeft>=c)view.scrollLeft-=c;while(view.scrollLeft<0)view.scrollLeft+=c}}
 function delay(ms){pausedUntil=Date.now()+ms}
 view.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0)return;drag={x:e.clientX,s:view.scrollLeft,id:e.pointerId};moved=false;pausedUntil=0;view.classList.add('dy-grabbing');try{view.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}});
 view.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(!drag)return;var dx=e.clientX-drag.x;if(Math.abs(dx)>5)moved=true;var next=drag.s-dx,c=cycle();if(next<0&&c>0){drag.s+=c;next+=c}view.scrollLeft=next;if(moved)e.preventDefault()});
 function end(){if(!drag)return;var id=drag.id;drag=null;normalize();view.classList.remove('dy-grabbing');try{if(view.hasPointerCapture(id))view.releasePointerCapture(id)}catch(_){}delay(180);if(moved){view.dataset.dySwiped='1';setTimeout(function(){delete view.dataset.dySwiped},420)}}
 view.addEventListener('pointerup',end);view.addEventListener('pointercancel',end);view.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',end);w.addEventListener('blur',end);
 view.addEventListener('pointerenter',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='mouse')hover=true});view.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='mouse'){hover=false;delay(250)}});
 view.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(view.dataset.dySwiped){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}},true);view.addEventListener('dragstart',function(e){e.preventDefault()});
 view.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){var delta=Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY)?e.deltaX:(e.shiftKey?e.deltaY:0);if(!delta)return;view.scrollLeft+=delta;normalize();delay(900);e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
 function frame(ts){if(!last)last=ts;var dt=Math.min(.05,(ts-last)/1000);last=ts;if(auto&&!drag&&!hover&&Date.now()>pausedUntil&&!reduced&&!d.hidden&&track&&track.scrollWidth>view.clientWidth+8){view.scrollLeft+=speed*dt;normalize()}w.requestAnimationFrame(frame)}w.requestAnimationFrame(frame)
 }
 function scan(){
 if(d.body&&d.body.classList.contains('fk-home'))return;
 d.querySelectorAll('.kvsd-mqwrap').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.kvsd-mq'),72,true)});
 d.querySelectorAll('.kn-rowwrap').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.kn-track'),72,true)});
 d.querySelectorAll('.dyw-marquee').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.dyw-category-track'),72,true)});
 d.querySelectorAll('.marquee').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.marquee-track'),72,true)});
 d.querySelectorAll('.dy-related-viewport').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.dy-related-track'),72,true)});
 d.querySelectorAll('.ar-viewport').forEach(function(v){bind(v,null,0,false)});
 }
 if(d.readyState==='loading')d.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',scan);else scan();new MutationObserver(scan).observe(d.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})(window,document);
</script>
<!-- DY_CONTINUOUS_MOTION_END -->

<!--
 Static preview mirroring finance-by-ca-kushal-theme.xml.
 Install the XML via Blogger > Theme > Restore. The pill (bottom-left)
 switches between the page types the template renders.
-->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link crossorigin="anonymous" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" rel="preconnect"/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500;1,600&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>
/* ============ 0. Tokens ============ */
:root{
 --paper:#F8F0E3; --surface:#FFFDF8; --ink:#241610; --muted:#7A6A58;
 --accent:#BC5B33; --accent-dark:#9C4522; --accent-soft:#F6E3D3;
 --line:#EADCC8; --footer-bg:#1D1109;
 --font-body:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
 --font-display:"Playfair Display",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
 --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
}
/* ============ 1. Foundation ============ */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
html.drawer-open,html.drawer-open body,html.search-open body{overflow:hidden}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:400 16.5px/1.78 var(--font-body);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;animation:pageIn.8s ease}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;line-height:1.16;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(880px 460px at 86% -80px,rgba(223,164,94,.20),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(720px 430px at -90px 220px,rgba(210,122,90,.15),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(640px 520px at 108% 58%,rgba(190,200,172,.14),transparent 62%)}
em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent-dark)}.post-title em,.FeaturedPost.title em,.header-widget.title em,.error-page.code{color:var(--accent-dark,#9C4522)}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.widget{margin:0;padding:0}.section{min-width:0}.shell{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px);padding-right:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity.9s var(--ease),transform.9s var(--ease)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;z-index:95;pointer-events:none}
#progressBar{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-dark))}.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}
/* ============ 2. Top bar ============ */.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(248,240,227,.85);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:border-color.4s ease,background.4s ease,box-shadow.4s ease}.topbar.is-scrolled{border-bottom-color:var(--line);background:rgba(248,240,227,.95);box-shadow:0 14px 44px -32px rgba(36,22,16,.35)}.topbar-inner{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,28px);height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.topbar-title{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;text-align:center;font:700 15px/1.25 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;transition:color.35s var(--ease)}
a.topbar-title:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}.touch-icon{width:42px;height:42px;flex:none;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:color.3s,border-color.3s,background.3s,transform.3s var(--ease)}.touch-icon:hover{color:var(--accent-dark);border-color:var(--line);background:var(--surface);transform:translateY(-1px)}.touch-icon svg{width:21px;height:21px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
/* ============ 3. Blog header ============ */.blog-head{padding:clamp(46px,7vw,84px) 0 clamp(26px,4vw,44px);text-align:center}.blog-head.widget{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.header-widget h1{font-size:clamp(31px,3.2vw,46px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 18px}.header-widget a.header-title{transition:color.35s var(--ease)}.header-widget a.header-title:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}.header-widget.description{margin:0 auto;max-width:62ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.9}.header-widget.description::after{content:"";display:block;width:54px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);margin:26px auto 0}
/* ============ 4. Pages tabs ============ */
#page_list_top{padding-bottom:clamp(26px,4vw,40px)}.PageList h3.title{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}.PageList ul.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:4px clamp(18px,3vw,34px);list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.PageList ul.tabs a{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:8px 2px;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);transition:color.35s var(--ease)}.PageList ul.tabs a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:2px;width:100%;height:1px;background:var(--accent);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:right;transition:transform.45s var(--ease)}.PageList ul.tabs a:hover{color:var(--ink)}.PageList ul.tabs a:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1);transform-origin:left}
/* ============ 5. Expanding search ============ */
#search_top{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:125;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px;background:rgba(36,22,16,.45);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity.45s ease,visibility 0s linear.45s}
html.search-open #search_top{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity.45s ease}
#search_top.widget{width:min(560px,94vw);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface);padding:18px;box-shadow:0 40px 90px -50px rgba(36,22,16,.55);transform:translateY(14px) scale(.985);transition:transform.5s var(--ease)}html.search-open #search_top.widget{transform:none}
#search_top h3.title{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
#search_top form{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;margin-right:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;background:var(--paper);padding:4px 6px 4px 18px;transition:border-color.35s,box-shadow.35s}
#search_top form:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}
#search_top input[name=q]{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;padding:11px 0;font:400 15px/1.4 var(--font-body);color:var(--ink);outline:none}
#search_top input[name=q]::placeholder{color:#A89478}
#search_top.search-submit-container{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8;cursor:pointer;transition:background.35s}
#search_top.search-submit-container:hover{background:var(--accent-dark)}
#search_top.search-submit-container input[type=submit]{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}
#search_top.search-submit-container svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;pointer-events:none}
/* ============ 7. Status message ============ */.status-msg-wrap{margin:0 0 clamp(20px,3vw,30px);padding:14px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7}.status-msg-wrap a{color:var(--accent-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent)}
/* ============ 8. Blog posts ============ */
#page_body{padding-bottom:clamp(56px,8vw,96px)}
/* posts feed : one card per row on every screen */.blog-posts{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px);padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.blog-posts &gt; *{min-width:0}.blog-posts.post-outer-container{display:flex}.blog-posts.post-outer{flex:1 1 auto}.blog-posts.post.post-footer{margin-top:auto}.blog-posts h3.post-title{font-size:clamp(20px,1.7vw,25px);line-height:1.28}
@media (max-width:640px){.blog-posts{gap:16px;padding:0 16px}}.post-outer-container{margin:0}.post-outer{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform.45s var(--ease),box-shadow.45s var(--ease),border-color.45s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#E0CFAF;box-shadow:0 28px 60px -44px rgba(36,22,16,.45)}.snippet-thumbnail-container{display:block;overflow:hidden;background:var(--accent-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/8}.snippet-thumbnail{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover.snippet-thumbnail{transform:scale(1.05)}.snippet-thumbnail.no-img{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface) 75%)}.no-img-art{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--accent)}.no-img-art svg{width:min(220px,52%);height:auto}.post{padding:clamp(20px,3vw,30px) clamp(20px,3vw,32px) clamp(20px,3vw,26px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;flex:1}.post-title-container{width:100%;min-width:0}
h3.post-title,h1.post-title{overflow-wrap:break-word}
h3.post-title,h1.post-title{font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,29px);line-height:1.26;letter-spacing:-.012em;margin:0 0 12px}.item-post h1.post-title{font-size:clamp(27px,2.9vw,40px);line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 14px}
h3.post-title a,h1.post-title a{background-image:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor);background-size:0% 1px;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:0 97%;transition:background-size.55s var(--ease),color.35s var(--ease)}
h3.post-title a:hover,h1.post-title a:hover{background-size:100% 1px;color:var(--accent-dark)}.post-header{width:100%}.post-header-line-1{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;font:500 10.5px/1.6 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}.byline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
a.timestamp-link{color:var(--muted);transition:color.3s}
a.timestamp-link:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}

@media (max-width:920px){.toc{position:static;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;gap:4px;border:0;padding-bottom:10px}.toc a{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;white-space:nowrap}.toc a.active{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}}.doc-body section{padding:clamp(26px,4vw,44px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.doc-body section:last-child{border-bottom:0}.sec-num{font:italic 600 15px/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.1em;display:block;margin-bottom:12px}.doc-body h2{font-size:clamp(23px,2.6vw,32px);letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 18px}.doc-body p{color:#4A3B2F;margin:0 0 1.1em}.doc-body ul{margin:0 0 1.1em;padding-left:1.3em;color:#4A3B2F}.doc-body li{margin-bottom:.55em}.doc-body li::marker{color:var(--accent)}
/* cookies table */
table{width:100%;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0;margin:1.2em 0;font-size:14px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}

/* illustrative toggles */.toggles{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,36px);margin-top:1.4em}.toggles.hint{font:600 15px/1.3 var(--font-script);color:var(--rust);margin:0 0 6px}.tg-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}.tg-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}.tg-row b{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}.tg-row small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:2px}.switch[disabled]{cursor:default;opacity:.85}.switch{position:relative;flex:none;width:52px;height:29px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--line);transition:background.35s;cursor:pointer;border:0}.switch::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:23px;height:23px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(36,22,16,.25);transition:transform.35s var(--ease)}.switch[aria-checked="true"]{background:var(--accent)}.switch[aria-checked="true"]::after{transform:translateX(23px)}.tg-note{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}
/* rights grid */.rights{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:1em}
@media (max-width:640px){.rights{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.right{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:15px 17px;font-size:14px;color:#4A3B2F;transition:transform.4s var(--ease),border-color.4s}.right:hover{transform:translateX(6px);border-color:var(--copper)}.right b{color:var(--ink)}.right.rnum{flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-dark);display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body)}

/* ==== v2 · shared ==== */
#spot{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity.9s}
#spot.on{opacity:1}.scribble{position:absolute;right:clamp(24px,5vw,90px);top:clamp(90px,10vw,150px);font:600 clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px)/1.2 var(--font-script);color:var(--accent-dark);transform:rotate(-6deg);animation:heroUp 1s var(--ease).6s both}.scribble svg{display:block;margin-top:6px;overflow:visible}.scribble path{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:160;stroke-dashoffset:160;animation:draw 1.2s var(--ease) 1s forwards}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@media (max-width:1180px){.scribble{display:none}}.hero{position:relative}
/* ==== v2 · data flow ==== */.flow{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:clamp(10px,2vw,18px);margin:0 0 clamp(34px,5vw,64px);flex-wrap:wrap}.fnode{flex:1;min-width:200px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:20px 22px;position:relative;transition:transform.45s var(--ease),border-color.45s}.fnode:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--copper)}.fnode.fnum{position:absolute;top:-13px;left:20px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grad);color:#FFF6E8;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 12px/1 var(--font-body);box-shadow:0 8px 18px -8px rgba(169,78,38,.6)}.fnode b{display:block;font:600 16px/1.3 var(--font-display);margin:4px 0 6px}.fnode small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.6}.farrow{flex:none;width:clamp(48px,6vw,84px);align-self:center;overflow:visible}.farrow path{stroke:var(--copper);stroke-width:2;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.farrow.dash{stroke-dasharray:6 7;animation:march 1.2s linear infinite}

@media (max-width:760px){.farrow{display:none}.flow{flex-direction:column}}
/* ==== v2 · third-party tiles ==== */.tp-tiles{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:0 0 1.2em}.tp{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);font:600 11.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);transition:.3s var(--ease)}.tp:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--copper);color:var(--accent-dark)}
/* ==== v2 · glossary term ==== */.term{border-bottom:1.5px dotted var(--copper);cursor:help;position:relative;white-space:nowrap}.term:hover,.term:focus-visible{color:var(--accent-dark)}.term::after{content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(100% + 10px);transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);width:max-content;max-width:260px;background:var(--ink);color:#FFF6E8;font:400 12.5px/1.55 var(--font-body);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);z-index:40;white-space:normal;text-align:left}.term::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(100% + 4px);transform:translateX(-50%);border:6px solid transparent;border-top-color:var(--ink);opacity:0;transition:.3s var(--ease);z-index:40}.term:hover::after,.term:hover::before,.term:focus-visible::after,.term:focus-visible::before{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
/* ==== v2 · consent rehearsal ==== */.consent-demo{position:relative;border:1.5px dashed var(--copper);border-radius:10px;padding:clamp(16px,2.4vw,24px);margin-top:1.4em;background:var(--paper);overflow:hidden}.cd-cap{font:600 15px/1.3 var(--font-script);color:var(--rust);margin:0 0 12px}.cd-banner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:16px 18px;max-height:260px;transition:.6s var(--ease)}.cd-banner.away{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);max-height:0;padding-top:0;padding-bottom:0;border-width:0;margin:0}.cd-banner b{display:block;font-size:14.5px}.cd-banner small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-top:2px}.cd-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.cd-btn{padding:11px 20px;border:1px solid var(--copper);border-radius:999px;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark);transition:.3s var(--ease)}.cd-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:var(--accent-soft)}.cd-btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}.cd-btn.primary:hover{background:var(--accent-dark)}.cd-done{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:600 21px/1.3 var(--font-script);color:var(--rust)}.cd-done[hidden]{display:none}.cd-reset{font:600 10px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;transition:.3s}.cd-reset:hover{color:var(--accent-dark);border-color:var(--copper)}
/* ==== v2 · retention bars ==== */.keep{margin:1.3em 0}.keep-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr auto;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}.keep-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
@media (max-width:640px){.keep-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}}.kl{font-size:13.8px;font-weight:600}.kbar{height:10px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--accent-soft);overflow:hidden}.kbar i{display:block;height:100%;width:var(--w);border-radius:99px;background:var(--grad)}.keep.pre.kbar i{width:0}.keep.go.kbar i{width:var(--w);transition:width 1.1s var(--ease)}.keep-row:nth-child(2).kbar i{transition-delay:.15s}.keep-row:nth-child(3).kbar i{transition-delay:.3s}.kv{font:600 19px/1 var(--font-script);color:#8A6B3A;white-space:nowrap}
@media (max-width:640px){.kv{white-space:normal}}

#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
#scrollTop{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:90;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -22px rgba(36,22,16,.5);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(14px);transition:.45s var(--ease)}
#scrollTop.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}
#scrollTop:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
#scrollTop svg.ring{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
#scrollTop.track{fill:none;stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:2.5}
#scrollTop.prog{fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.5;stroke-linecap:round}
#scrollTop.arr{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--accent-dark);fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.spark{position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:var(--gold);animation:sparkFly.9s var(--ease) forwards}
@keyframes sparkFly{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) rotate(var(--rot)) scale(.2);opacity:0}}.toc-count{display:block;margin-top:14px;padding:0 18px;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.toc-count b{color:var(--accent-dark)}
@media (max-width:920px){.toc-count{display:none}}
@media print{#scrollTop,#spot,#toast{display:none!important}}

/* ============ footer directory ============ */
footer{background:var(--footer-bg);margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,80px)}.foot-grid{width:100%;padding:clamp(34px,4.5vw,60px) clamp(20px,5vw,64px) clamp(22px,3vw,34px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(24px,3.5vw,44px)}
@media (max-width:980px){.foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media (max-width:560px){.foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.fcol b{display:block;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#D9A05B;margin-bottom:16px}.fcol p{margin:0 0 12px;color:#BCAC94;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8}.fcol a{display:inline-block;color:#D8C7AE;font-size:13.5px;line-height:2.1;text-decoration:none;background:linear-gradient(#F0C084,#F0C084) no-repeat 0 100%/0 1px;transition:color.3s,background-size.35s var(--ease)}.fcol a:hover{color:#F0C084;background-size:100% 1px}.frooms{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 18px}.fsoc{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:6px}.fsoc a{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid #3A2A1C;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#D9A05B;background:none;line-height:1;transition:.3s var(--ease)}.fsoc a:hover{border-color:#D9A05B;transform:translateY(-3px);background:none;background-size:0}.fsoc svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.foot-base{width:100%;padding:18px clamp(20px,5vw,64px) 26px;border-top:1px solid #2E2013;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#A2927D;font-size:12px}

/* ============ motion pack ============ */.hero{position:relative}.fglyphs{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}.fglyphs i{position:absolute;font:italic 600 clamp(26px,3.4vw,44px)/1 var(--font-display);color:rgba(169,78,38,.10);animation:glyphFloat 9s ease-in-out infinite}.fglyphs i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-2.2s}.fglyphs i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-4.4s}.fglyphs i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-6.6s}.fglyphs i:nth-child(5){animation-delay:-8.1s}
@keyframes glyphFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-6deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-22px) rotate(7deg)}}.tilt{will-change:transform}.reveal.in.kicker::before{animation:ruleGrow.9s var(--ease).15s backwards}
@keyframes ruleGrow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
/* contact */.dots{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;margin-top:16px}.dots i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--copper);animation:kbounce 1.2s ease infinite}.dots i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}.dots i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes kbounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.45}50%{transform:translateY(-7px);opacity:1}}.routes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;padding:0 0 clamp(40px,6vw,70px)}
@media (max-width:980px){.routes{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:560px){.routes{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.route{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:22px;transition:transform.4s var(--ease),border-color.4s}.route:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--copper)}.route .rico{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-dark);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}.route .rico svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.route h3{font-size:16.5px;margin:0 0 6px}.route p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.4px;line-height:1.7}.route a{font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--copper);padding-bottom:3px}
/* disclaimer */
section.reveal.will-reveal.flags li{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-18px)}
section.reveal.in.flags li{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity.6s var(--ease),transform.6s var(--ease)}
section.reveal.in.flags li:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.12s}
section.reveal.in.flags li:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.24s}
section.reveal.in.flags li:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.36s}.log li::before{animation:kpulse 2.6s ease infinite}
@keyframes kpulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(188,91,51,.45)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(188,91,51,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(188,91,51,0)}}
/* privacy */.lockdraw{display:inline-block;vertical-align:-7px;margin-left:12px;width:28px;height:28px;stroke:var(--accent);fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.lockdraw rect,.lockdraw path{stroke-dasharray:44;stroke-dashoffset:44}
section.reveal.in.lockdraw rect,section.reveal.in.lockdraw path{animation:kdraw.8s var(--ease) forwards}
section.reveal.in.lockdraw path{animation-delay:.4s}
@keyframes kdraw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
ol.uses{counter-reset:u;list-style:none;margin:1.2em 0 0;padding:0}
ol.uses li{counter-increment:u;position:relative;padding:12px 0 12px 56px;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);color:#4A3B2F;font-size:14.6px;line-height:1.7}
ol.uses li:last-child{border:0}
ol.uses li::before{content:"0" counter(u);position:absolute;left:0;top:14px;font:italic 600 19px/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--gold)}.twolists{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:1.2em 0 0}
@media (max-width:700px){.twolists{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.tlist{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:18px 20px}.tlist b{display:block;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark);margin-bottom:10px}.tlist ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.2em;color:#4A3B2F;font-size:13.8px}.tlist li{margin-bottom:.45em}

/* ============ motion+ pack ============ */
@keyframes wordUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(.55em)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}.hero h1.ws,.hero.lede.ws{animation:none;opacity:1}.hero h1.w,.hero.lede.w{display:inline-block;animation:wordUp.8s var(--ease) backwards}.w-safe.hero.w,.w-safe.hero h1.w,.w-safe.hero.lede.w{animation:none!important}
@keyframes rwIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(.5em) rotateX(45deg);filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:blur(0)}}

@keyframes aurora{to{transform:translate(4%,-3%) rotate(5deg)}}.reveal.will-reveal{transform:translateY(28px) scale(.988)}.stat b:not(.all){color:var(--accent-dark,#9C4522)}
@keyframes glint{0%,55%,100%{background-position:110% 0}75%{background-position:-10% 0}}.btn{overflow:hidden}.btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 32%,rgba(255,246,232,.32) 50%,transparent 68%);transform:translateX(-130%);transition:transform.85s var(--ease);pointer-events:none;z-index:2}.btn:hover::after{transform:translateX(130%)}.section-head h2,.story h2,.faq h2,.doc-body h2{transition:letter-spacing 1.15s var(--ease)}.reveal.will-reveal h2{letter-spacing:.045em}
#cur{position:fixed;z-index:180;left:0;top:0;width:26px;height:26px;border:1px solid rgba(188,91,51,.45);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:width.3s var(--ease),height.3s var(--ease),opacity.4s,border-color.3s,background.3s}

/* ============ motion v3 · every element, every paragraph ============ */
body{animation:pgIn.7s var(--ease)}

<section class="reveal" id="p1">
<span class="sec-num">§ 01</span>
<h2>What we collect</h2>
<ul>
<li><b>What you give:</b> your email address and message, only if you choose to email the inbox. Name only if you type it.</li>
<li><b>What Blogger logs:</b> <span class="term" data-tip="The standard line items every web server records — think of it as the doorbell register, not a dossier." tabindex="0">standard server data</span> (IP, browser type, pages visited, timestamps) processed by Google as platform operator.</li>
<li><b>What we don't:</b> no forms that profile you, IP-country lookups on some tool pages, no advertising profiles built about you.</li>
</ul>
<div class="twolists">
<div class="tlist"><b>You provide — voluntarily</b>
<ul><li>Name (only if you type it)</li><li>Email address</li><li>Website URL (if you share one)</li><li>The contents of your message</li></ul>
</div>
<div class="tlist"><b>Logged — automatically, like most websites</b>
<ul><li>Internet Protocol (IP) address</li><li>Browser type & ISP</li><li>Date & time stamps</li><li>Referring / exit pages & click counts</li></ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="p2">
<span class="sec-num">§ 02</span>
<h2>How it's used</h2>
<p>Three uses, and only three: responding to relevant correspondence; replying to your message; and understanding — <span class="term" data-tip="Aggregate — grouped counts with no names, no addresses, no identities inside." tabindex="0">in aggregate</span> — which reports are read, so the calendar follows genuine interest. In full, the six standing uses:</p>
<ol class="uses">
<li><b>Operate & optimise</b> — keep the website performing.</li>
<li><b>Improve content & experience</b> — better reports, fewer irritants.</li>
<li><b>Understand visitor behaviour</b> — in aggregate, never individually.</li>
<li><b>Develop new tools & resources</b> — calculators, checklists, trackers.</li>
<li><b>Communicate</b> — updates and insights you actually asked for.</li>
<li><b>Fraud & spam prevention</b> — keep the comment boxes clean.</li>
</ol>
</section>

<div class="right"><span class="rnum">02</span><span><b>Correct</b> — fix anything inaccurate you've shared.</span></div>

<div class="right"><span class="rnum">06</span><span><b>Withdraw</b> — pull any consent you granted, no explanation owed.</span></div>
</div>

<p>Protecting children online is a top priority. This journal is written for adults making money decisions, and no Personal Identifiable Information is knowingly collected from children under 18. /* ═════════ page components (disclaimer-page) ═════════ */

:root{
 --paper:#F8F0E3; --surface:#FFFDF8; --ink:#241610; --muted:#6E5D4B;
 --accent:#BC5B33; --accent-dark:#9C4522; --accent-soft:#F6E3D3;

body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
 background:radial-gradient(880px 460px at 86% -80px,rgba(223,164,94,.20),transparent 62%),
 radial-gradient(720px 430px at -90px 220px,rgba(210,122,90,.14),transparent 60%)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;line-height:1.18;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.wrap{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,5vw,64px);padding-right:clamp(20px,5vw,64px)}.reveal{transition:opacity 1s var(--ease),transform 1s var(--ease)}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}.touch-icon{width:42px;height:42px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:.3s}.touch-icon:hover{color:var(--accent-dark);background:var(--surface)}.touch-icon svg{width:21px;height:21px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
/* hero */.hero{padding:clamp(56px,8vw,110px) 0 clamp(30px,4vw,54px);position:relative}.badge-row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:26px}.badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--accent-soft);font:600 10px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark);animation:floatIn.9s var(--ease) both}.badge:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s;background:transparent}.badge:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.24s;background:transparent}

@media (max-width:900px){.keys{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.key{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:clamp(22px,2.6vw,32px);overflow:hidden;transition:transform.5s var(--ease),border-color.5s,box-shadow.5s var(--ease)}.key:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--copper);box-shadow:0 26px 60px -46px rgba(36,22,16,.5)}.key::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:3px;background:var(--grad);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform.6s var(--ease)}.key:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.key .ico{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:13px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-dark);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}.key .ico svg{width:22px;height:22px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.key h3{font-size:17.5px;margin:0 0 8px}.key p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14.2px;line-height:1.8}
/* doc layout */.doc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(28px,5vw,72px);padding:clamp(30px,4vw,60px) 0 clamp(60px,8vw,100px)}
@media (max-width:920px){.doc{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.toc{position:sticky;top:96px;align-self:start;border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:4px}.toc a{display:block;position:relative;padding:9px 18px;font:500 12.5px/1.5 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted);border-left:2px solid transparent;margin-left:-5px;transition:color.3s,border-color.3s,padding.3s var(--ease)}.toc a:hover{color:var(--ink)}.toc a.active{color:var(--accent-dark);border-left-color:var(--accent);padding-left:24px}
@media (max-width:920px){.toc{position:static;display:flex;overflow-x:auto;gap:4px;border:0;padding-bottom:10px}.toc a{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;white-space:nowrap}.toc a.active{border-color:var(--accent);background:var(--accent-soft)}}.doc-body section{padding:clamp(26px,4vw,44px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.doc-body section:last-child{border-bottom:0}.sec-num{font:italic 600 15px/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.1em;display:block;margin-bottom:12px}.doc-body h2{font-size:clamp(23px,2.6vw,32px);letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 18px}.doc-body p{color:#4A3B2F;margin:0 0 1.1em}.doc-body ul{margin:0 0 1.1em;padding-left:1.3em;color:#4A3B2F}.doc-body li{margin-bottom:.55em}.doc-body li::marker{color:var(--accent)}.callout{display:flex;gap:16px;background:var(--accent-soft);border:1px solid #EAD4BE;border-radius:8px;padding:18px 20px;margin:1.2em 0;font-size:14.6px;line-height:1.8;color:#8A3E1F}.callout svg{flex:none;width:20px;height:20px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;margin-top:3px}
/* flag list */.flags{list-style:none;margin:1em 0 0;padding:0}.flags li{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);color:#4A3B2F}.flags li:last-child{border:0}.flags.x{flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-dark);display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12px/1 var(--font-body)}
/* updates log */.log{list-style:none;margin:1.2em 0 0;padding:0}.log li{position:relative;padding:0 0 22px 30px}.log li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:5px;top:8px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}.log li::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8.5px;top:20px;bottom:-2px;width:1px;background:var(--line)}.log li:last-child::after{display:none}.log b{display:block;font:600 12px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark);margin-bottom:5px}.log span{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
/* acknowledge stamp */.ack{margin-top:clamp(36px,5vw,64px);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:clamp(26px,3.4vw,44px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:24px;align-items:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
@media (max-width:760px){.ack{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.ack label{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;color:#4A3B2F}.ack input{position:absolute;opacity:0}.ack.box{flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border:1.6px solid var(--copper);border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:background.3s,transform.3s var(--ease)}.ack.box svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:#FFF6E8;fill:none;stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-dasharray:24;stroke-dashoffset:24;transition:stroke-dashoffset.45s var(--ease).1s}.ack input:checked +.box{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);transform:rotate(-4deg) scale(1.06)}.ack input:checked +.box svg{stroke-dashoffset:0}.stamp{position:relative;width:132px;height:74px;justify-self:end;border:2.5px double var(--copper);border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--accent-dark);font:600 13px/1.3 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;transform:rotate(8deg) scale(0);opacity:0;transition:transform.55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),opacity.4s}.ack.done.stamp{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1);opacity:1}
@media (max-width:760px){.stamp{justify-self:start}}

/* ==== v2 · shared ==== */.kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:0 0 20px;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}.kicker::before{content:"";width:46px;height:1px;background:var(--accent)}.section-head{padding:clamp(30px,4vw,56px) 0 clamp(20px,3vw,32px)}.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.8vw,48px);letter-spacing:-.02em}
#spot{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity.9s}
#spot.on{opacity:1}.scribble{position:absolute;right:clamp(24px,5vw,90px);top:clamp(120px,12vw,180px);font:600 clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px)/1.2 var(--font-script);color:var(--accent-dark);transform:rotate(-6deg);animation:heroUp 1s var(--ease).6s both}.scribble svg{display:block;margin-top:6px;overflow:visible}.scribble path{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2;fill:none;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:160;stroke-dashoffset:160;animation:draw 1.2s var(--ease) 1s forwards}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@media (max-width:1180px){.scribble{display:none}}
/* ==== v2 · TL;DR note ==== */.tldr{position:relative;max-width:880px;background:#FFF9E8;border:1px solid #F0E2B8;border-radius:8px;padding:clamp(26px,3.4vw,44px) clamp(24px,3.2vw,42px);box-shadow:0 30px 70px -52px rgba(36,22,16,.55);transform:rotate(-1.1deg);transition:transform.5s var(--ease)}.tldr:hover{transform:rotate(0)}.tldr::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg);width:110px;height:30px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(223,164,94,.6),rgba(223,164,94,.4));border-radius:2px}.tldr-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}.tldr-head b{font:600 12px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rust)}.tldr ol{margin:0;padding-left:1.4em}.tldr li{margin-bottom:.5em;color:#4A3B2F;font-size:15.2px;line-height:1.8}.tldr li::marker{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}.tldr-foot{display:block;margin-top:16px;font:600 19px/1 var(--font-script);color:#8A6B3A;transform:rotate(-1deg)}
/* ==== v2 · glossary tooltips ==== */.term{border-bottom:1.5px dotted var(--copper);cursor:help;position:relative;white-space:nowrap}.term:hover,.term:focus-visible{color:var(--accent-dark)}.term::after{content:attr(data-tip);position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(100% + 10px);transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);width:max-content;max-width:260px;background:var(--ink);color:#FFF6E8;font:400 12.5px/1.55 var(--font-body);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.3s var(--ease);z-index:40;white-space:normal;text-align:left}.term::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:calc(100% + 4px);transform:translateX(-50%);border:6px solid transparent;border-top-color:var(--ink);opacity:0;transition:.3s var(--ease);z-index:40}.term:hover::after,.term:hover::before,.term:focus-visible::after,.term:focus-visible::before{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
/* ==== v2 · flip cards ==== */.flips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:clamp(14px,2vw,24px);padding-bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,54px)}
@media (max-width:900px){.flips{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.flip{perspective:1200px;cursor:pointer;min-height:210px}.flip-in{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:210px;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform.8s var(--ease)}.flip.flipped.flip-in,.flip:hover.flip-in{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
@media (hover:none){.flip:hover.flip-in{transform:none}.flip.flipped.flip-in{transform:rotateY(180deg)}}.flip-f,.flip-b{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;border-radius:10px;padding:clamp(20px,2.4vw,30px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:14px}.flip-f{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 24px 60px -46px rgba(36,22,16,.5)}.flip-f.tag{font:600 9.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--rust)}.flip-f.q{font:italic 600 clamp(19px,1.9vw,24px)/1.4 var(--font-display);margin:0}.flip-f.hint{font:600 9.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.flip-f.hint::after{content:"↻";font-size:14px;letter-spacing:0;animation:hintSpin 3.4s ease infinite}
@keyframes hintSpin{0%,88%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}94%{transform:rotate(180deg)}}.flip-b{background:var(--grad);color:#FFF6E8;transform:rotateY(180deg);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -40px rgba(169,78,38,.65)}.flip-b p{margin:0;font-size:14.6px;line-height:1.75}.flip-b small{font:600 9px/1.4 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.8}
/* ==== v2 · correction steps ==== */.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin:1.4em 0 1.6em}
@media (max-width:700px){.steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.step{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:18px 20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;transition:transform.4s var(--ease),border-color.4s}.step:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--copper)}.step b{font:italic 600 22px/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--gold)}.step span{font-size:13.8px;color:#4A3B2F;line-height:1.5}.step:not(:last-child)::after{content:"→";position:absolute;right:-15px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--copper);font-size:16px;z-index:2}
@media (max-width:700px){.step:not(:last-child)::after{display:none}}
/* ==== v2 · toc counter ==== */.toc-count{display:block;margin-top:14px;padding:0 18px;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.22em;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.toc-count b{color:var(--accent-dark)}
@media (max-width:920px){.toc-count{display:none}}
/* ==== v2 · toast / scrolltop / spark ==== */
#toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,16px);z-index:150;background:var(--ink);color:#FFF6E8;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.03em;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.4s var(--ease);box-shadow:0 20px 50px -20px rgba(36,22,16,.6)}
#toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
#scrollTop{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:90;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -22px rgba(36,22,16,.5);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(14px);transition:.45s var(--ease)}
#scrollTop.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}
#scrollTop:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
#scrollTop svg.ring{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
#scrollTop.track{fill:none;stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:2.5}
#scrollTop.prog{fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.5;stroke-linecap:round}
#scrollTop.arr{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--accent-dark);fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.spark{position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;font-size:13px;line-height:1;color:var(--gold);animation:sparkFly.9s var(--ease) forwards}
@keyframes sparkFly{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) rotate(var(--rot)) scale(.2);opacity:0}}
@media print{#scrollTop,#spot,#toast{display:none!important}}

/* ============ footer directory ============ */
footer{background:var(--footer-bg);margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,80px)}.foot-grid{width:100%;padding:clamp(34px,4.5vw,60px) clamp(20px,5vw,64px) clamp(22px,3vw,34px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(24px,3.5vw,44px)}

@media (max-width:560px){.foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.fcol b{display:block;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#D9A05B;margin-bottom:16px}.fcol p{margin:0 0 12px;color:#BCAC94;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8}.fcol a{display:inline-block;color:#D8C7AE;font-size:13.5px;line-height:2.1;text-decoration:none;background:linear-gradient(#F0C084,#F0C084) no-repeat 0 100%/0 1px;transition:color.3s,background-size.35s var(--ease)}.fcol a:hover{color:#F0C084;background-size:100% 1px}.frooms{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 18px}.fsoc{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:6px}.fsoc a{width:40px;height:40px;border:1px solid #3A2A1C;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#D9A05B;background:none;line-height:1;transition:.3s var(--ease)}.fsoc a:hover{border-color:#D9A05B;transform:translateY(-3px);background:none;background-size:0}.fsoc svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.foot-base{width:100%;padding:18px clamp(20px,5vw,64px) 26px;border-top:1px solid #2E2013;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#A2927D;font-size:12px}

/* ============ motion pack ============ */.hero{position:relative}.fglyphs{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}.fglyphs i{position:absolute;font:italic 600 clamp(26px,3.4vw,44px)/1 var(--font-display);color:rgba(169,78,38,.10);animation:glyphFloat 9s ease-in-out infinite}.fglyphs i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-2.2s}.fglyphs i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-4.4s}.fglyphs i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-6.6s}.fglyphs i:nth-child(5){animation-delay:-8.1s}
@keyframes glyphFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-6deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-22px) rotate(7deg)}}.tilt{will-change:transform}.reveal.in.kicker::before{animation:ruleGrow.9s var(--ease).15s backwards}
@keyframes ruleGrow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
/* contact */.dots{display:inline-flex;gap:6px;margin-top:16px}.dots i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--copper);animation:kbounce 1.2s ease infinite}.dots i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}.dots i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes kbounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:.45}50%{transform:translateY(-7px);opacity:1}}.routes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;padding:0 0 clamp(40px,6vw,70px)}
@media (max-width:980px){.routes{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:560px){.routes{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.route{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:22px;transition:transform.4s var(--ease),border-color.4s}.route:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--copper)}.route .rico{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-dark);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}.route .rico svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.route h3{font-size:16.5px;margin:0 0 6px}.route p{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13.4px;line-height:1.7}.route a{font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--copper);padding-bottom:3px}
/* disclaimer */
section.reveal.will-reveal.flags li{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-18px)}
section.reveal.in.flags li{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity.6s var(--ease),transform.6s var(--ease)}
section.reveal.in.flags li:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.12s}
section.reveal.in.flags li:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.24s}
section.reveal.in.flags li:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.36s}.log li::before{animation:kpulse 2.6s ease infinite}
@keyframes kpulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(188,91,51,.45)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(188,91,51,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(188,91,51,0)}}
/* privacy */.lockdraw{display:inline-block;vertical-align:-7px;margin-left:12px;width:28px;height:28px;stroke:var(--accent);fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.lockdraw rect,.lockdraw path{stroke-dasharray:44;stroke-dashoffset:44}
section.reveal.in.lockdraw rect,section.reveal.in.lockdraw path{animation:kdraw.8s var(--ease) forwards}
section.reveal.in.lockdraw path{animation-delay:.4s}
@keyframes kdraw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
ol.uses{counter-reset:u;list-style:none;margin:1.2em 0 0;padding:0}
ol.uses li{counter-increment:u;position:relative;padding:12px 0 12px 56px;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);color:#4A3B2F;font-size:14.6px;line-height:1.7}
ol.uses li:last-child{border:0}
ol.uses li::before{content:"0" counter(u);position:absolute;left:0;top:14px;font:italic 600 19px/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--gold)}.twolists{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:1.2em 0 0}
@media (max-width:700px){.twolists{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.tlist{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:18px 20px}.tlist b{display:block;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark);margin-bottom:10px}.tlist ul{margin:0;padding-left:1.2em;color:#4A3B2F;font-size:13.8px}.tlist li{margin-bottom:.45em}

/* ============ motion+ pack ============ */
@keyframes wordUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(.55em)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}.hero h1.ws,.hero.lede.ws{animation:none;opacity:1}.hero h1.w,.hero.lede.w{display:inline-block;animation:wordUp.8s var(--ease) backwards}.w-safe.hero.w,.w-safe.hero h1.w,.w-safe.hero.lede.w{animation:none!important}
@keyframes rwIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(.5em) rotateX(45deg);filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:blur(0)}}
body::after{content:"";position:fixed;inset:-20%;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(620px 420px at 18% 28%,rgba(190,200,172,.10),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(540px 400px at 82% 72%,rgba(223,164,94,.11),transparent 60%);animation:aurora 26s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes aurora{to{transform:translate(4%,-3%) rotate(5deg)}}.reveal.will-reveal{transform:translateY(28px) scale(.988)}.stat b:not(.all){color:var(--accent-dark,#9C4522)}
@keyframes glint{0%,55%,100%{background-position:110% 0}75%{background-position:-10% 0}}.btn{overflow:hidden}.btn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 32%,rgba(255,246,232,.32) 50%,transparent 68%);transform:translateX(-130%);transition:transform.85s var(--ease);pointer-events:none;z-index:2}.btn:hover::after{transform:translateX(130%)}.section-head h2,.story h2,.faq h2,.doc-body h2{transition:letter-spacing 1.15s var(--ease)}.reveal.will-reveal h2{letter-spacing:.045em}
#cur{position:fixed;z-index:180;left:0;top:0;width:26px;height:26px;border:1px solid rgba(188,91,51,.45);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:width.3s var(--ease),height.3s var(--ease),opacity.4s,border-color.3s,background.3s}
#cur.on{opacity:1}
#cur.big{width:46px;height:46px;background:rgba(223,164,94,.14);border-color:transparent}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){body::after{display:none}#cur{display:none}.hero h1.w,.hero.lede.w{animation:none}}

/* ============ motion v3 · every element, every paragraph ============ */
body{animation:pgIn.7s var(--ease)}
@keyframes pgIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}.hero h1 em{background-size:200% 100%;animation:emShift 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}

<section class="reveal" id="s1">
<span class="sec-num">§ 01</span>
<h2>Purpose of this blog</h2>
<p>Daily Yield publishes research-led educational writing on personal finance, investing and money psychology. Content is prepared with reasonable care and is general in nature — it cannot and does not consider your objectives, financial situation or needs. Everything here is created solely for educational, informational and entertainment purposes — it is not professional financial, investment, legal or tax advice.</p>
<div class="callout"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"></circle><path d="M12 8v4.5M12 16h.01"></path></svg><span>Nothing on this blog is a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security, product or scheme.</span></div>
<div class="callout"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h10"></path></svg><span>This disclaimer governs your use of the journal — articles, guides, newsletters and tools. By continuing to read, you acknowledge that you have read and understood it.</span></div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s2">
<span class="sec-num">§ 02</span>
<h2>No personal advice</h2>
<p>I am a Certified Accountant, but on this blog I am a writer — not <i>your</i> accountant, tax adviser or investment adviser. No professional relationship is created by reading, subscribing or commenting. Before acting on anything here, consult a qualified professional who can see your complete picture and is accountable for it.</p>
<ul>
<li>Tax rules, interest rates and product features change — often silently.</li>
<li>Worked examples use illustrative numbers, not predictions.</li>
<li>What suits one balance sheet can be entirely wrong for the next one.</li>
</ul>
<p>To be exact about credentials: this desk is not a CFP, a registered investment adviser or a licensed broker — and no professional-client or fiduciary relationship is created through any channel, comments, email or social media included.</p>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s3">
<span class="sec-num">§ 03</span>
<h2>Accuracy & dates</h2>
<p>Facts are checked against sources believed reliable at publication. Reports are dated; the further a report is from today, the more its numbers may have drifted. Corrections, when needed, are made openly with a dated note at the end of the piece.</p>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s4">
<span class="sec-num">§ 04</span>
<h2>Market risk</h2>
<p>Investing involves risk, including possible loss of <span class="term" data-tip="Principal — the original amount you put in, before any gains or losses." tabindex="0">principal</span>. <span class="term" data-tip="Diversification — spreading money across uncorrelated bets, so one failure can’t sink the ship." tabindex="0">Diversification</span>, horizon and behaviour matter more than any single decision discussed here. Never invest borrowed money, and never invest an amount whose loss would change your life.</p>
<div class="steps">
<div class="step"><b>01</b><span>Conduct your own thorough research</span></div>
<div class="step"><b>02</b><span>Assess your personal risk tolerance & finances</span></div>
<div class="step"><b>03</b><span>Consult a licensed professional or certified accountant</span></div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s5">
<span class="sec-num">§ 05</span>
<h2>Red flags to watch — anywhere</h2>
<ul class="flags">
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Guaranteed returns. Markets offer probabilities, never guarantees.</li>
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Urgency. "This week only" is a sales tactic, not a market condition.</li>
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Secrets. Genuine edge rarely needs to be whispered in a DM.</li>
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Unregistered "advisers". Verify credentials before you verify their track record.</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s6">
<span class="sec-num">§ 06</span>
<h2>Sponsorships & affiliates</h2>
<p>No paid reviews. No paid links. If a collaboration ever appears on this blog, it will be <span class="term" data-tip="Disclosed — stated openly, before you read another line. No fine print inside fine print." tabindex="0">disclosed clearly</span> at the top of the piece, and editorial conclusions will remain independent — the report may be commissioned, never the verdict.</p>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s7">
<span class="sec-num">§ 07</span>
<h2>External links & embedded content</h2>
<p>Reports may link to external websites — data sources, official documents, tools and videos — and may embed charts or media from third parties. Those sites operate under their own terms and privacy practices; no responsibility is taken for their content, accuracy or availability.</p>
<p>An external link is a citation, never an endorsement of everything the destination may publish today or tomorrow.</p>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s8">
<span class="sec-num">§ 08</span>
<h2>Limitation of liability</h2>
<p>By using this journal you agree that the owner, author and affiliates are not liable for any financial losses, damages or negative outcomes resulting directly or indirectly from the use of, reliance on, or inability to use the information published here.</p>
<div class="callout"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"></circle><path d="M12 8v4.5M12 16h.01"></path></svg><span>You assume full responsibility for every financial decision you make. The working is shared so you can check it — the decision, and its outcome, remain yours.</span></div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s9">
<span class="sec-num">§ 09</span>
<h2>Jurisdiction</h2>
<p>Content is written for a global readership but the author is based in India; examples use Indian and international data. Rules differ by country and by person. This disclaimer is governed by Indian law; nothing here constitutes legal advice for any jurisdiction.</p>
</section>

<style>
/* ============ 0. Tokens ============ */
:root{

}
/* ============ 1. Foundation ============ */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}

em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent-dark)}.post-title em,.FeaturedPost.title em,.header-widget.title em,.error-page.code{color:var(--accent-dark,#9C4522)}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.widget{margin:0;padding:0}.section{min-width:0}.shell{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px);padding-right:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity.9s var(--ease),transform.9s var(--ease)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;z-index:95;pointer-events:none}
#progressBar{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-dark))}.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}
/* ============ 2. Top bar ============ */.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(248,240,227,.85);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:border-color.4s ease,background.4s ease,box-shadow.4s ease}.topbar.is-scrolled{border-bottom-color:var(--line);background:rgba(248,240,227,.95);box-shadow:0 14px 44px -32px rgba(36,22,16,.35)}.topbar-inner{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,28px);height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.topbar-title{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;text-align:center;font:700 15px/1.25 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;transition:color.35s var(--ease)}

/* ============ 3. Blog header ============ */.blog-head{padding:clamp(46px,7vw,84px) 0 clamp(26px,4vw,44px);text-align:center}.blog-head.widget{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.header-widget h1{font-size:clamp(31px,3.2vw,46px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 18px}.header-widget a.header-title{transition:color.35s var(--ease)}.header-widget a.header-title:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}.header-widget.description{margin:0 auto;max-width:62ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.9}.header-widget.description::after{content:"";display:block;width:54px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);margin:26px auto 0}

/* ============ 5. Expanding search ============ */
#search_top{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:125;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px;background:rgba(36,22,16,.45);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity.45s ease,visibility 0s linear.45s}

/* ============ 7. Status message ============ */.status-msg-wrap{margin:0 0 clamp(20px,3vw,30px);padding:14px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7}.status-msg-wrap a{color:var(--accent-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent)}
/* ============ 8. Blog posts ============ */
#page_body{padding-bottom:clamp(56px,8vw,96px)}
/* posts feed : one card per row on every screen */.blog-posts{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px);padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.blog-posts &gt; *{min-width:0}.blog-posts.post-outer-container{display:flex}.blog-posts.post-outer{flex:1 1 auto}.blog-posts.post.post-footer{margin-top:auto}.blog-posts h3.post-title{font-size:clamp(20px,1.7vw,25px);line-height:1.28}
@media (max-width:640px){.blog-posts{gap:16px;padding:0 16px}}.post-outer-container{margin:0}.post-outer{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform.45s var(--ease),box-shadow.45s var(--ease),border-color.45s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#E0CFAF;box-shadow:0 28px 60px -44px rgba(36,22,16,.45)}.snippet-thumbnail-container{display:block;overflow:hidden;background:var(--accent-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/8}.snippet-thumbnail{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover.snippet-thumbnail{transform:scale(1.05)}.snippet-thumbnail.no-img{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface) 75%)}.no-img-art{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--accent)}.no-img-art svg{width:min(220px,52%);height:auto}.post{padding:clamp(20px,3vw,30px) clamp(20px,3vw,32px) clamp(20px,3vw,26px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;flex:1}.post-title-container{width:100%;min-width:0}
h3.post-title,h1.post-title{overflow-wrap:break-word}
h3.post-title,h1.post-title{font-size:clamp(22px,2.8vw,29px);line-height:1.26;letter-spacing:-.012em;margin:0 0 12px}.item-post h1.post-title{font-size:clamp(27px,2.9vw,40px);line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 14px}
h3.post-title a,h1.post-title a{background-image:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor);background-size:0% 1px;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:0 97%;transition:background-size.55s var(--ease),color.35s var(--ease)}
h3.post-title a:hover,h1.post-title a:hover{background-size:100% 1px;color:var(--accent-dark)}.post-header{width:100%}.post-header-line-1{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 14px;font:500 10.5px/1.6 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}.byline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
a.timestamp-link{color:var(--muted);transition:color.3s}

a.comment-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--muted);transition:color.3s}

a.comment-link svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.labels-outer-container{width:100%;margin-top:12px}.labels-container{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}.post-labels a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;font:500 10px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);transition:all.35s var(--ease)}.post-labels a:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-dark);background:var(--accent-soft);transform:translateY(-2px)}.post-body-container{width:100%}.post-snippet{margin:14px 0 4px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
a.jump-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-top:16px;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark)}
a.jump-link.arr{transition:transform.45s var(--ease)}
a.jump-link:hover.arr{transform:translateX(5px)}.item-post.post-body{width:100%;max-width:none;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px);margin-top:26px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.92;color:#2B2721;overflow-wrap:break-word}.item-post.post-body p{margin:0 0 1.55em}.item-post.post-body &gt; p:first-of-type::first-letter{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:3.4em;line-height:.8;float:left;padding:8px 13px 0 0;color:var(--accent-dark)}.item-post.post-body h2{margin:2em 0.7em;font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,31px)}.item-post.post-body h3{margin:2em 0.7em;font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,25px)}.item-post.post-body a{color:var(--accent-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent);transition:border-color.3s,background.3s}.item-post.post-body a:hover{border-bottom-color:transparent;background:var(--accent-soft)}.item-post.post-body ul,.item-post.post-body ol{margin:0 0 1.6em;padding-left:1.4em}.item-post.post-body li{margin-bottom:.5em}.item-post.post-body li::marker{color:var(--accent)}.item-post.post-body blockquote{margin:2.4em 0;padding:8px 8px 8px 28px;border-left:2px solid var(--accent);font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:20px;line-height:1.6}.item-post.post-body table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:2em 0;font-size:14.5px}.item-post.post-body th{font:600 10.5px/1.4 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:left}.item-post.post-body th,.item-post.post-body td{padding:12px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}

#featured_post{padding:clamp(8px,1.5vw,16px) clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px) 0}
#featured_post.widget{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 26px 60px -48px rgba(36,22,16,.4)}.featured-card{display:block}.featured-thumb{display:block;overflow:hidden;background:var(--accent-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/7}.featured-thumb svg{width:100%;height:100%}.featured-kicker{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;font:600 9.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark)}.featured-kicker::before{content:"";width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent)}.FeaturedPost.widget-content{padding:clamp(22px,3.4vw,34px)}.FeaturedPost.title{font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,29px);line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 12px}.FeaturedPost.title a{background-image:linear-gradient(currentColor,currentColor);background-size:0% 1px;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:0 96%;transition:background-size.55s var(--ease),color.35s var(--ease)}.FeaturedPost.title a:hover{background-size:100% 1px;color:var(--accent-dark)}.FeaturedPost.snippet{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;margin:0 0 16px}

/* ---- pager ---- */
#blog-pager{width:100%;margin:clamp(30px,4.5vw,46px) 0 0;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px);display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}.blog-pager a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 30px;border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:2px;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);background:transparent;transition:all.4s var(--ease)}.blog-pager a:hover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px -18px rgba(36,22,16,.5)}.blog-pager.arr{display:inline-block;transition:transform.4s var(--ease)}.blog-pager a:hover.arr{transform:translateX(4px)}

/* ============ 9. Drawer sidebar ============ */.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:110;background:rgba(36,22,16,.45);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity.45s ease,visibility 0s linear.45s;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(2px);backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
html.drawer-open.scrim{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity.45s ease}.sidebar-container{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:120;width:min(370px,90vw);background:var(--paper);border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:-40px 0 90px -50px rgba(36,22,16,.5);transform:translateX(105%);transition:transform.55s var(--ease);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:18px 24px 40px}
html.drawer-open.sidebar-container{transform:none}.sidebar-back{margin-left:auto;display:grid}.sidebar-container.widget{margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface);padding:4px 18px}.sidebar-container details.collapsible &gt; summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 0}.sidebar-container details.collapsible &gt; summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.sidebar-container.collapsible-title{display:flex;align-items:center;flex:1}.sidebar-container.collapsible-title h3.title{margin:0;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}.sidebar-container.chevron-down,.sidebar-container.chevron-up{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:var(--accent);fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform.4s var(--ease)}.sidebar-container.chevron-up{display:none}.sidebar-container details[open].chevron-down{display:none}.sidebar-container details[open].chevron-up{display:block}.sidebar-container.widget-content{padding:0 0 14px}.sidebar-container details[open].collapsible &gt;.widget-content{animation:drawerIn.5s var(--ease)}

/* ============ 10. Comments ============ */

/* ============ 0. Tokens ============ */
:root{
 --paper:#F8F0E3; --surface:#FFFDF8; --ink:#241610; --muted:#7A6A58;

/* ============ 1. Foundation ============ */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}

button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;line-height:1.16;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(880px 460px at 86% -80px,rgba(223,164,94,.20),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(720px 430px at -90px 220px,rgba(210,122,90,.15),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(640px 520px at 108% 58%,rgba(190,200,172,.14),transparent 62%)}
em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent-dark)}.post-title em,.FeaturedPost.title em,.header-widget.title em,.error-page.code{color:var(--accent-dark,#9C4522)}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.widget{margin:0;padding:0}.section{min-width:0}.shell{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px);padding-right:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity.9s var(--ease),transform.9s var(--ease)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;z-index:95;pointer-events:none}

/* ============ 3. Blog header ============ */.blog-head{padding:clamp(46px,7vw,84px) 0 clamp(26px,4vw,44px);text-align:center}.blog-head.widget{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.header-widget h1{font-size:clamp(31px,3.2vw,46px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 18px}.header-widget a.header-title{transition:color.35s var(--ease)}.header-widget a.header-title:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}.header-widget.description{margin:0 auto;max-width:62ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.9}.header-widget.description::after{content:"";display:block;width:54px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);margin:26px auto 0}

<details class="qa reveal"><summary>Will you cover a specific topic?<span class="plus"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"></path></svg></span></summary><div class="ans">Very likely — reader questions drive the calendar. <details class="qa reveal"><summary>Do you reply to comments on posts?<span class="plus"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"></path></svg></span></summary><div class="ans">Yes — every single one, usually within a day or two. /* ============ design tokens ============ */
:root{

::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.wrap{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,5vw,64px);padding-right:clamp(20px,5vw,64px)}

/* ============ marquee ============ */.marquee{margin:clamp(48px,7vw,90px) 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 0;overflow:hidden;position:relative}.marquee-track{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:scrollX 30s linear infinite}.marquee:hover.marquee-track{animation-play-state:paused}.marquee span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;padding:0 26px;font:italic 500 clamp(17px,2vw,24px)/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}.marquee i{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent);font-size:12px}
